content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-226. - Fees.
content.summary:
All new applications for licenses shall be accompanied by an application fee of $50.00
               and a yearly license fee of $50.00, for a total of $100.00. Thereafter, licenses shall
               be subject to a yearly license fee of $50.00.
(Code 1981, § 6-105; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-199…
